# serial.open

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Open a serial connection (only on TANDEM radios)

```lua
serial.open(name[, baudrate[, mode[, power]]])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `baudrate` | unsigned | optional (default `57600`) |  |
| `mode` | string | optional (default `"8N1"`) |  |
| `power` | boolean | optional (default `true`) |  |

## Returns

the new serial connection

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local conn = serial.open("sport", 9600, "8N1")
print(conn:empty())
print(conn:read())
conn:write(...)
conn:flush()
```
